arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-vps-supervisor-release.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone -q --depth 1 --branch fix/passive-supervisor-vps-telegram-20261031 https://github.com/martaxi-boss/VPS.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 5b89aadc43f0fe2d406b6e19b411e0bdc4599ca3
git fetch -q --depth 1 origin main
git diff --check origin/main HEAD
echo SUPERVISOR_CHANGES_CLEAN=PASS
python3 -m py_compile ops/supervisor_live.py ops/supervisor_cloud_source.py ops/supervisor_audit.py ops/telegram_gateway.py
python3 -m unittest discover -s ops/tests -p 'test_supervisor_cloud_source.py' -q
echo SUPERVISOR_OFFLINE_TESTS=PASS
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import os
import sys
import tempfile
import types
import json
text=Path('.github/workflows/cloud-supervisor-observation.yml').read_text(encoding='utf8')
try:
 import yaml
 doc=yaml.safe_load(text)
 job=doc['jobs']['observe-cloud']
 script=job['steps'][-1]['run']
 assert job['if']=="github.event_name != 'pull_request'"
 assert 'VPS_SSH_PASSWORD' in str(job['steps'][-1]['env']['SSHPASS'])
 print('SUPERVISOR_YAML_PARSE=PASS')
except ImportError:
 start=text.index('        run: |\n',text.index('name: Run existing passive Supervisor on VPS'))
 end=text.index('\n  offline-contract:',start)
 script='\n'.join(line[10:] for line in text[start+len('        run: |\n'):end].splitlines())
 print('SUPERVISOR_YAML_PARSE=NOT_VERIFIED')
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='supervisor-workflow-test-') as d:
 path=Path(d)/'run.sh'
 path.write_text(script,encoding='utf8')
 subprocess.run(['bash','-n',str(path)],check=True)
 print('SUPERVISOR_SHELL_SYNTAX=PASS')
 lines=script.splitlines()
 def heredoc(marker):
  starts=[i for i,l in enumerate(lines) if "<<'"+marker+"'" in l]
  if len(starts)!=1:raise AssertionError('Herodoc '+marker+' missing or ambiguous')
  end=lines.index(marker,starts[0]+1)
  return '\n'.join(lines[starts[0]+1:end])+'\n'
 remote=heredoc('PYREMOTE')
 delivery=heredoc('PYDELIVERY')
 compile(remote,'remote.py','exec')
 compile(delivery,'delivery.py','exec')
 print('SUPERVISOR_REMOTE_AND_DELIVERY_SYNTAX=PASS')
 result=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-c',remote],text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=100,check=False)
 if result.returncode:
  print('SUPERVISOR_REMOTE_EXECUTION_EXIT='+str(result.returncode))
  print(result.stderr[-1200:])
  raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 assert 'SUPERVISOR_EXECUTION_HOST=VPS' in result.stdout
 assert 'SUPERVISOR_PUBLIC_AUDIT=PASS' in result.stdout
 msgs=[l for l in result.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('SUPERVISOR_AUDITED_JSON=')]
 print('SUPERVISOR_REMOTE_EXECUTION=PASS; NOTICE_COUNT='+str(len(msgs)))
 (Path(d)/'supervisor-vps-observation').write_text(result.stdout,encoding='utf8')
 os.environ.update({'RUNNER_TEMP':d,'GITHUB_SHA':'8e1df4ab82856485a8eb565ae73d2965b326bc5b',
                    'GITHUB_EVENT_NAME':'schedule'})
 fake=types.ModuleType('ops.telegram_gateway')
 sent=[]
 fake.say=lambda message:sent.append(message)
 sys.modules['ops.telegram_gateway']=fake
 exec(compile(delivery,'delivery.py','exec'),{})
 assert len(sent)==len(msgs)
 print('SUPERVISOR_DELIVERY_PARSER=PASS; DRY_RUN_COUNT='+str(len(sent)))
PY
echo SUPERVISOR_CANDIDATE_CERTIFIED=PASS
